title: 2025 Tibet earthquake
summary: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck Dingri (Tingri) County, Shigatse, Tibet Autonomous Region, on 7 January 2025 at a depth of about 10 km. Chinese state media reported at least 126 dead, and tremors were felt in Nepal, Bhutan and northern India. Radio Free Asia questioned the official death toll.

uncertainty.note: Date and local time consistent across both sources.

where.modern_name: Cuoguo Township, Dingri (Tingri) County, Shigatse, Tibet Autonomous Region, China
where.historical_name: Dingri County, Tibet Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China

importance.justification: Largest normal-faulting event in the central and western Tibetan Plateau since 2008, with at least 126 reported deaths.

audience_note: Concerns a deadly disaster; the death toll is disputed and reports differ.
